evidence.title: Roberts halts imminent deadline for FCC to rule on Democrats’ TV ad rate challenge

occurrences.checkable_against: Republican Supreme Court appeal filing in the television advertising-rate challenge
occurrences.quote_span: Republicans’ appeal accused them of attempting an “end run” around the Supreme Court’s previous order.
occurrences.speaker: Republicans' appeal
occurrences.subject: Chief Justice John Roberts's order halting the Federal Communications Commission deadline on television ad rates

occurrences.checkable_against: Chief Justice John Roberts's Supreme Court emergency order in the FCC television advertising-rate case
occurrences.quote_span: Chief Justice John Roberts halted, for now, a deadline for the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to rule on Democrats’ challenge to a policy giving party committees access to cheaper television ad rates in the lead-up to the midterms.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chief Justice John Roberts's order halting the Federal Communications Commission deadline on television ad rates

occurrences.checkable_against: Republican Senate and House campaign committee filings and statements about the FCC television advertising-rate litigation
occurrences.quote_span: The administration’s bid is backed by Republicans’ Senate and House campaign arms, which boast a cash advantage and hope to use the policy to bolster their chances in holding onto control of Congress in November’s contests.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Chief Justice John Roberts's order halting the Federal Communications Commission deadline on television ad rates
